title: Nashville's Cumberland Cottage
description:
Relax with the whole family at this peaceful cottage 6 miles to downtown , Opryland and other great attractions in Nashville. This home sleeps 10 comfortably it has 4 bedrooms 3 full bathrooms.  There is a huge outdoor patio area with a bar , hot tub , fire pit and a beautiful back yard .

The space
Our sweet Cottage is set up for the best vacation experience , we have tried to think of everything you might need. 
The house has beds to sleep everyone comfortably 4 spacious bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms .
Bedroom 1-Queen, Bedroom 2 - 2 bunk beds , Bedroom 3 - Queen bed, Bedroom 4 - King bed. Pack and play available upon request. 
 There is a large outdoor patio area with a bar and a hot tub as well as a spacious private yard with a fire pit , grill a swing and plenty of parking.

Guest access
You have the home to your self during your stay the hot tub and yard are all part of the wonderful experience of the home.

Other things to note
We are in a residential neighborhood and we like our neighbors so please be respectful and keep your voices to a nice level when you are outside enjoying yourself .
